products.title: Premium Backrest
products.body_html:
Take your sauna comfort to the next level. 

Whether you prefer to sit back, stretch out, or fully recline, this backrest is designed to provide versatile support while enhancing every sauna session. This innovative design features a supportive CELLIANT®-infused woven surface that creates a softer, more comfortable place to lean, rest, and recover. 

Sunlighten's CELLIANT-infused fabric is woven with natural, heat-reactive minerals that work with your body's natural energy and the sauna's infrared heat. As you relax, the fabric helps convert body heat into infrared energy and reflect it back to the body, extending the infrared experience while providing plush comfort. CELLIANT technology is permanently embedded into the fibers, delivering lasting performance session after session. 

Move it wherever you need support during your session, against the wall for a comfortable recline, beneath your back for an upper-body incline, or under your knees for lower-back relief. 

Designed for flexibility, comfort, and infrared-enhanced relaxation, it will help you make the most of every minute in your sauna.

products.title: Signature I - Eucalyptus - Black Edition
products.body_html:
Made for one. Darker by design.

Obsidian outside. Natural eucalyptus inside.

Signature I Obsidian is the smallest cabin in the Signature line, made for one person and one purpose. Premium black on the outside, natural sustainably sourced eucalyptus on the inside, the same wood as our Eucalyptus models. Push one button and settle into gentle, even far infrared from patented SoloCarbon® heaters, the technology behind every Sunlighten sauna. No programs to learn, no settings to manage. Sized for a single seat, which means it asks less of your floor plan and nothing of your schedule. Chromotherapy lighting and a premium Bluetooth sound system let you set the mood, or leave both off and take the quiet. Supports detoxification through deep sweating, circulation, immune health, and relaxation.

Space for four means it becomes a shared ritual instead of a solo one, and there is still plenty of bench when you want it to yourself. Chromotherapy lighting and a premium Bluetooth sound system round out the session. Supports detoxification through deep sweating, circulation, immune health, and relaxation.

products.title: The Circadian Foundation System
products.body_html:
A full and vital life begins with a strong foundation of wellness. Designed to support muscle recovery, energize cells, improve sleep, reduce inflammation, smooth skin, strengthen immunity, and support healthy aging, each RED/NIR light therapy panel session becomes a transformative daily ritual. Blending guided wellness programs with advanced light science in a nature-inspired design, restorative results unfold in minutes—helping you feel renewed, balanced, and energized every day.

Extend those benefits beyond the session and into the night with our luxury Performance Sheets. Made with CELLIANT®-infused infrared-reflecting fibers, they work with your body as you sleep—helping regulate temperature, promote recovery, and enhance sleep quality. Soft, cool, and perfectly weighted, they transform your bed into a restorative sanctuary so your body can repair, recharge, and wake ready for the day ahead.

Together, this bundle creates a complete sleep and recovery system—supporting your wellness both day and night.

products.title: The Targeted Circadian System
products.body_html:
Wellness often begins with the moments that need attention most. Designed for targeted recovery and renewal, the RED Light Therapy Mini Panel delivers focused red and near-infrared light exactly where your body needs it. Compact enough to move with your daily rhythm, yet powerful enough to make a difference, it helps improve sleep, smooth skin, and support muscle repair—turning small moments of care into meaningful results.

Extend that recovery into the hours that matter most with our luxury Performance Sheets. Made with CELLIANT®-infused infrared-reflecting fibers, they work with your body throughout the night to help regulate temperature, promote recovery, and support deeper, more restorative sleep. Soft, cool, and perfectly weighted, they create a calming environment designed for true rest.

Together, this bundle forms a targeted sleep and recovery system—delivering focused light therapy by day and restorative infrared-enhanced sleep by night, so your body can repair, renew, and wake ready for what’s next.

Stay on schedule with a quick warm-up, stay ahead of your game with intense heat, and sweat deep. Supports performance, recovery, and longevity.

products.title: Solo System Chromo
products.body_html:
Not everyone has the space or budget for a cabin sauna. But everyone needs the benefits of infrared.

For a healthier, happier you, envelop your entire body with the potent benefits of Sunlighten’s patented SoloCarbon® far infrared heating technology, engineered to produce an exceptionally high quantity of far infrared. Infrared density matters — the more far infrared your body absorbs, the more effectively it can support circulation, promote a deep sweat, ease muscle tension, and encourage relaxation. Our advanced heater is proven to raise core body temperature rather than simply heating the surrounding air, creating a more comfortable yet highly effective session!

products.title: Floor Stand
products.body_html:
This Floor Stand option is designed for you to easily move your RED Light Therapy Panel and RED Light Therapy Mini Panel to any space in your home. It lets you enjoy your RED/NIR light therapy while sitting or standing, and makes sharing it with others easy, too. Add it to a yoga session, pre- or post-workout, relax with a book, work or meditate while benefitting from this adaptable and attractive setup. 
 
Both practical and pretty, its modern design is engineered for durability and simplicity. Contoured, powder-coated sheet metal ensures exceptional strength and stability, while the high-quality eucalyptus wood element adds natural elegance.

products.title: Door Hanger
products.body_html:
Enjoy targeted light therapy exactly where you need it. The Door Hanger makes it easy to use your RED Light Therapy Panel or RED Light Therapy Mini Panel for convenient upper-body exposure while standing—for spaces where desk, floor or wall placement isn’t ideal. Designed to mount quickly on any door less than 2” thick, it’s a simple way to add red and near-infrared light therapy to your bedroom, gym or bathroom routine.  

Crafted from contoured, powder-coated sheet metal, the Door Hanger offers exceptional strength and stability while maintaining a clean, modern look. Holds one panel and integrates seamlessly into your self-care routine.

products.title: Wide Wall Mount
products.body_html:
Hanging your RED Light Therapy Panel or RED Light Therapy Mini Panel on the wall with this minimalist wide wall mount allows you to stand comfortably while covering more of your upper body at once—with space to mount up to two panels. Stretch, work out, or meditate while enjoying the benefits of red and near-infrared light therapy. 

With durability and refined simplicity, the contoured, powder-coated sheet metal provides outstanding strength and stability. Its modern design adds sophistication to any space.   

  • Integrated rear slots make mounting the [RLT Panel] or [Mini Panel] simple 
  • Adjustable to different height options ([RLT Panel] only) 
  • Fits up to two RLT Panel devices 
  • Width designed to anchor directly into 2 wall studs for optimal stability

products.body_html:

products.body_html:
Sunlighten’s affordable personal, portable sauna is different than an infrared sauna blanket. It is constructed with non-toxic bamboo carbon material and our patented infrared heaters that deliver radiant warmth into your body, not just heats up your skin.

This is the same far infrared in our cabin saunas, independently tested and proven 99% emissive with a max. temperature of 150°F. This portable infrared sauna not only aids in effective detoxification but also releases stress, combats symptoms of depression, revitalizes your mind, bolsters immunity, and enhances circulation.

Stand it up, lay it down, move it around as you need.

  • Sit with supported recline–lean it against the wall
  • Create an incline for your upper body while laying down–lay it flat under your back
  • Support your lower back while laying down–place it under your knees
  • Lift your feet–use it as a footrest on the floor or bench

Durable wood construction for optimal support.

Dimensions  22 x 18 x 6 in

products.title: Solo Pad
products.body_html:
SoloPad® is our most affordable and easy-to-store infrared therapy option if you're looking for a luxurious therapeutic infrared heating pad, It uses the same patented far infrared heaters as our cabins and Solo® Dome, enveloped in plush 4" memory cushion to conform to your body for ultimate comfort and contact. Place on the floor, bed, sofa, or chair for far infrared therapy anytime, anywhere (see Warranty Info). Or combine with the Solo® Dome portable sauna for total body surround far infrared heat in a peaceful, portable sauna experience.

*The heaters are located at the bottom of the Solopad® and should not be placed directly on the floor.  We recommend using an extra wide massage table, non-toxic yoga mat, bed, or on the floor layered with thick blankets or towels.

Includes

  • 4 SoloCarbon® heaters, proven 95-99% effective
  • Plush 4” memory foam conforms to your body
  • Ergonomic design relieves stress on the lower back
  • Three fold points for easy storage
  • Encased in durable commercial-grade fabric
  • Easy to clean, stain resistant, certified nontoxic
  • Digital control has 12 hour timer and 9 heat settings
  • Perfect fit with  Solo® Domes to intensify portable sauna experience

Pillow sold separately
